e.title: **由一份 R Markdown 技术报告当首要文档，论文只做缩短的学术摘要**：一个为中东欧养老金计划评估长寿风险的项目**逐字写明它有两件相关产出**——**一篇投给某欧洲精算期刊的科学论文，**与**一份「**面向实务的技术报告，**由 R Markdown 生成」**，**并逐字指出**「**技术报告是**首要的项目文档**。**它包含**完整的国别推导、**诊断评论、**实务建议与附录」**，**而论文「**提供的是方法、**部分结果与跨国比较的**较短的学术摘要」**；**其生成物为**十一个中东欧国家**的动态人口死亡率表**（**另加**三个 DACH 基准国**）
e.title_en: A technical report generated from R Markdown as the primary document, with a journal article serving only as the shorter academic summary: a project assessing longevity risk for pension plans in central and eastern Europe states verbatim that it has two related outputs, a scientific article prepared for submission to a European actuarial journal and a practitioner-oriented technical report generated from R Markdown, and states verbatim that the technical report is the primary project documentation containing the full country-level derivations, diagnostic comments, practical recommendations and appendices, while the article provides a shorter academic summary of the methodology, selected results and cross-country comparisons — the artefact being dynamic population mortality tables for eleven central and eastern European countries plus three benchmark countries
e.title_hk: **由一份 R Markdown 技術報告當首要文檔，論文只做縮短的學術摘要**：一個為中東歐養老金計劃評估長壽風險的項目**逐字寫明它有兩件相關產出**——**一篇投給某歐洲精算期刊的科學論文，**與**一份「**面向實務的技術報告，**由 R Markdown 生成」**，**並逐字指出**「**技術報告是**首要的項目文檔**。**它包含**完整的國別推導、**診斷評論、**實務建議與附錄」**，**而論文「**提供的是方法、**部分結果與跨國比較的**較短的學術摘要」**；**其生成物為**十一個中東歐國家**的動態人口死亡率表**（**另加**三個 DACH 基準國**）**
e.summary: 一个**为中东欧养老金计划评估长寿风险的项目**（★0、HTML、仓库体量 **426 MB**、**最后推送落在窗口之内**）：**逐字自述其目标是「**支持多个东欧国家的养老金提供方做风险管理评估，**同时也**为精算师提供把相关议题**向管理层与政策制定者讲清的工具与度量」**；**其最值得记的一处是它把**两份产出的主次写清****——**逐字「**技术报告是**首要的项目文档**」**，**而**论文「**是**较短的学术摘要**」**；**第二处是它的**生成物被逐条给出****（**动态人口死亡率表、**分年龄的死亡率改善率、**投射预期寿命、**年金现值、**以及**这些表在精算使用上的实务适用性**）；**第三处是它的**国家集**逐条列出**（**十一个中东欧国家：保加利亚、克罗地亚、捷克、爱沙尼亚、匈牙利、拉脱维亚、立陶宛、波兰、罗马尼亚、斯洛伐克、斯洛文尼亚**；**另加三个 DACH 基准国：奥地利、德国、瑞士**）
e.summary_hk: 一個**為中東歐養老金計劃評估長壽風險的項目**（★0、HTML、體量 **426 MB**、**最後推送落在窗口之內**）：**逐字自述其目標是「**支持多個東歐國家的養老金提供方做風險管理評估，**同時也**為精算師提供把相關議題**向管理層與政策制定者講清的工具與度量」**；**其最值得記的一處是它把**兩份產出的主次寫清****——**逐字「**技術報告是**首要的項目文檔**」**，而論文「**是**較短的學術摘要**」**；**第二處是它的**生成物被逐條給出****（**動態人口死亡率表、**分年齡的死亡率改善率、**投射預期壽命、**年金現值、**以及**這些表在精算使用上的實務適用性**）；**第三處是它的**國家集**逐條列出**（**十一個中東歐國家：保加利亞、克羅地亞、捷克、愛沙尼亞、匈牙利、拉脫維亞、立陶宛、波蘭、羅馬尼亞、斯洛伐克、斯洛文尼亞**；**另加三個 DACH 基準國：奧地利、德國、瑞士**）
e.summary_en: A project assessing longevity risk for pension plans in central and eastern Europe — 0 stars, HTML, a 426 MB repository, last pushed inside the window — stating its aim verbatim as supporting pension providers in various eastern European countries in their risk management assessments while also giving actuaries tools and measures to convey the relevant topics to management and policymakers. **Its most notable feature is that it states which of its two outputs is primary**: verbatim, the technical report is the primary project documentation, while the article provides the shorter academic summary. **The second is that its artefacts are listed one by one**: dynamic population mortality tables, age-specific mortality improvement rates, projected life expectancies, annuity present values, and the practical suitability of the resulting tables for actuarial use. **The third is that its country set is enumerated**, eleven central and eastern European countries together with three benchmark countries from the German-speaking region.
e.body:
**cee-longevity-tables**（仓库 `kainhofer/PensionLongevity`）**是一个为中东欧养老金计划评估长寿风险的项目**：**逐字自述其目标为**「**The aim of the VIG Longevity Risk Management Project is to support pension providers in various Eastern European Countries in their risk management assessments, but also to provide actuaries with tools and measures to convey the relevant topics to the management and policymakers.**」**。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可字段为 **NONE****（**⚠️ 三重信号一致，见下**）、主语言 HTML、仓库体量 **426,145 KB**、**创建 2026-05-31**、最后推送 **2026-09-10**、默认分支为 `master`**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**⭐ 创建与推送**都在解冻窗口之内****）；**README 实测 **12,548 字节****，**其开头逐字署名作者与其所属机构**（**一位具名作者，**并列出**一个全国性精算协会与一家保险公司**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「源与生成物」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本轮四条里**把「哪一份产物才算正式文档」写得最明确的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它把两份产出的**主次关系**写清**——**逐字为**：**「**The project consists of two related outputs: 1. a scientific article prepared for submission to the **European Actuarial Journal**. 2. a detailed **practitioner-oriented technical report, generated from R Markdown**; **The technical report is the primary project documentation.** It contains the **full country-level derivations, diagnostic comments, practical recommendations and appendices**. The EAJ article provides a **shorter academic summary** of the methodology, selected results and cross-country comparisons.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「首要的项目文档」是**技术报告而不是论文****——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所收条目里**对「什么算正式文档」给出的最不寻常的一个答案**（**⭐ 通常论文才是正式产物，**而这里**把**面向实务的长报告**放在首位**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **两份产出的**内容差别被逐条写出****（**报告含**完整国别推导、**诊断评论、**实务建议与附录**；**论文只含**方法、**部分结果与跨国比较**）**——**⭐ 即**读者知道**该读哪一份**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **技术报告的生产方式是**R Markdown 生成****（**⭐ 即**首要文档**本身是**生成物**，**源在别处**）；**④ ⭐⭐ **论文的投稿对象被点名**（**一个欧洲精算期刊**）**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「生成物」逐条列出，且末项是**适用性**本身**——**逐字为**：**「**The main focus is on: **population mortality levels**; **age-specific mortality improvement rates**; **dynamic population mortality tables**; **projected life expectancies**; **annuity present values**; **practical suitability of the resulting tables for actuarial use.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **五项里有三项是**数**、一项是**率**、**末项是**判断****（**「这些表在精算使用上的实务适用性」**）——**⭐ 即**它把**「能不能用」**也算成一项产出**（**⭐ 与第 348 轮 [[insurance-advisor-platform]] 的「哪些数还没有依据」同族**，**但这里**是对**自己的产物**提出适用性问题**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「动态」（dynamic）是表的一个属性**（**逐字 `dynamic population mortality tables`**）**——**⭐ 即**它不是一张静态表，**而是**可随年份推进的表**；**③ ⭐⭐ **预期寿命与年金现值都在列**（**⭐ 即**输出**面向**养老金与年金**两类用法**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它的国家集逐条列出，并明确区分**目标国**与**基准国****——**逐字为**：**「**The country set includes: **Bulgaria / Croatia / Czechia / Estonia / Hungary / Latvia / Lithuania / Poland / Romania / Slovakia / Slovenia**」**，**以及**「**For comparison purposes, selected Western European benchmark countries are also considered, in particular the DACH region: **Austria / Germany / Switzerland**」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **十一个国家被逐个点名**（**⭐ 即**覆盖面**可核对**，**而不是「中东欧若干国」**）；**② ⭐⭐ **基准国被标为「为比较之用」**（**⭐ 即**两组国家**在方法里的角色不同**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **「DACH 地区」是一个**区域缩写**（**⭐ 即**它按**语言／区域**而不是按国别大类分组**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **方法被写成一句可核对的话**——**逐字为**：**「**The mortality projections are based on a **Lee–Carter-type modelling framework**. For each country and sex, **age-specific mortality rates are analysed over time and a country-specific calibration period is selected.**」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **方法被归到一个具名框架**（**逐字 Lee–Carter 类型**）**——**⭐ 即**读者可以**去找该框架的原始文献**；**② ⭐⭐ **每个国家与性别**各自选一个校准期****（**逐字 `country-specific calibration period`**）**——**⭐ 即**参数化**是国家级的**，**而不是一套参数用到底**；**③ ⭐⭐ **它说明产出用途为**人口基准****（**逐字「这些表**意在作为精算工作的人口基准**，**尤其在养老金与年金语境下」**）**。**⑤ ⭐ 其余可核实细节**：**① **它逐字说明仓库里放的是**文档、源码与**算出来的死亡率表****（**⭐ 即**产物本身入库**）；**② **项目名里含一个保险集团的缩写**（**⭐ 即**资助或发起方被写进项目名**）；**③ **作者署名含一个全国性精算协会与一家保险公司**（**⭐ 本词条只如实转述其署名**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[mortalitylaws]]、[[stmomo]]、[[cvmortalitymult]]、[[gprmortality]]、[[mortcast]]、[[european-actuarial-journal]]、[[annals-of-actuarial-science]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **三重信号一致指向**没有许可声明****：**GitHub 许可字段为 **NONE****、**实测默认分支 `master` 的根目录 `LICENSE` 与 `LICENSE.md` 均不存在**（**raw 探测均为 HTTP 404**）、**且 README 全文以「licen／copyright／©」检索**零命中****——**⭐ 本词条指出这一处尤其要紧：**它**明确包含「算出来的死亡率表」与一份技术报告**，**而**「可以读到」与「可以再分发」是两件事****（**⚠️ 尤其**人口死亡率数据**通常另有来源条款——**本词条**未查任何数据来源条款**）。**② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **本次**没有运行它的任何一步****——**未安装 R、未渲染那份 R Markdown 技术报告、未运行任何建模代码、未打开其任何数据或结果、未打开任何图**；**故**本词条**不主张**其 Lee–Carter 类型建模、其校准期选择或其任何一张死亡率表**按其所述工作**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README 的**逐字内容**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其数据来源与授权**（**⭐ 即**未核对其用的是哪一国人口数据、**是否可再分发、**以及**其「动态表」的更新时间口径**）**——**⭐ 这是本条目**最需要后续核实的一处**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其表的实务适用性**（**⭐ 其自述把这一项列为产出之一**，**而**本词条**未做任何比较或检验**）。**⑤ ⭐ ⚠️ **一处**署名与关联**如实记录**：**其 README 开头署名为**一位具名作者 ＋ **一个全国性精算协会 ＋ **一家保险公司**，**项目名里另含一个保险集团缩写**——**⭐ 本词条**只如实转述其署名，**⚠️ 不主张**其与任何机构的关系细节**。**⑥ ⚠️ **★0、fork 0、无 topics**，**且**未核实其提交历史**。**⑦ ⚠️ **仓库体量 426 MB****——**⭐ 本词条**如实记录**：**这**属于本站所收条目里体量最大的一档**，**故**本次**未下载其任何内容**。**⑧ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/kainhofer/PensionLongevity` 于 2026-09-11 经仓库检索接口与 GitHub API 实测读取（★数、许可字段 NONE、语言、体量、创建／推送时间、默认分支）；README **12,548 字节**经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对（**含其署名行、两份产出的说明、国家集与方法一节**）；根目录 `LICENSE` 与 `LICENSE.md` 的存在经 raw 探测确认（均为 HTTP 404）；**未克隆、未下载其 426 MB 内容、未安装 R 或任何包、未渲染任何报告、未运行任何代码、未打开任何数据或图、未做其他网络观察**。
e.body_hk:
**cee-longevity-tables**（倉庫 `kainhofer/PensionLongevity`）**是一個為中東歐養老金計劃評估長壽風險的項目**：**逐字自述其目標為**「**The aim of the VIG Longevity Risk Management Project is to support pension providers in various Eastern European Countries in their risk management assessments, but also to provide actuaries with tools and measures to convey the relevant topics to the management and policymakers.**」**。**實測 ★0、fork 0、許可字段為 **NONE****（**⚠️ 三重信號一致，見下**）、主語言 HTML、體量 **426,145 KB**、**創建 2026-05-31**、最後推送 **2026-09-10**、默認分支 `master`**（**⭐ 創建與推送都在解凍窗口之內****）；**README 實測 **12,548 位元組****，**其開頭逐字署名作者與其所属機構**（**一位具名作者，並列出一個全國性精算協會與一家保險公司**）。本條目屬本輪主題**「源與生成物」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本輪四條裡**把「哪一份產物才算正式文檔」寫得最明確的一條****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 把兩份產出的**主次關係**寫清**——逐字「**The project consists of two related outputs: 1. a scientific article prepared for submission to the European Actuarial Journal. 2. a detailed practitioner-oriented technical report, generated from R Markdown; The technical report is the primary project documentation. It contains the full country-level derivations, diagnostic comments, practical recommendations and appendices. The EAJ article provides a shorter academic summary of the methodology, selected results and cross-country comparisons.**」**⭐⭐⭐ 四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「首要的項目文檔」是**技術報告而不是論文****（通常論文才是正式產物，而這裡把**面向實務的長報告**放在首位）；**② ⭐⭐⭐兩份產出的**內容差別被逐條寫出****（報告含完整國別推導／診斷評論／實務建議與附錄；論文只含方法／部分結果與跨國比較——讀者知道該讀哪一份）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐技術報告的生產方式是**R Markdown 生成****（首要文檔本身是**生成物**，源在別處）；**④ ⭐⭐論文投稿對象被點名**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **把「生成物」逐條列出，且末項是**適用性**本身**——逐字「**The main focus is on: population mortality levels; age-specific mortality improvement rates; dynamic population mortality tables; projected life expectancies; annuity present values; practical suitability of the resulting tables for actuarial use.**」**三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐五項裡三項是**數**、一項是**率**、末項是**判斷****（「這些表在精算使用上的實務適用性」——**「能不能用」也算成產出**；與第 348 輪 insurance-advisor-platform 的「哪些數還沒有依據」同族，但這裡是對**自己的產物**提出適用性問題）；**② ⭐⭐⭐「動態」（dynamic）是表的一個屬性**（不是一張靜態表，而是**可隨年份推進的表**）；**③ ⭐⭐預期壽命與年金現值都在列**（輸出面向**養老金與年金**兩類用法）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **國家集逐條列出，並明確區分**目標國**與**基準國****——逐字「**The country set includes: Bulgaria / Croatia / Czechia / Estonia / Hungary / Latvia / Lithuania / Poland / Romania / Slovakia / Slovenia**」與「**For comparison purposes, selected Western European benchmark countries are also considered, in particular the DACH region: Austria / Germany / Switzerland**」**三處**：**① ⭐⭐十一個國家被逐個點名**（覆蓋面可核對）；**② ⭐⭐基準國被標為「為比較之用」**（兩組國家在方法裡的角色不同）；**③ ⭐⭐「DACH 地區」是一個區域縮寫**（按語言／區域而不是按國別大類分組）。**④ ⭐⭐ **方法被寫成一句可核對的話**——逐字「**The mortality projections are based on a Lee–Carter-type modelling framework. For each country and sex, age-specific mortality rates are analysed over time and a country-specific calibration period is selected.**」**三處**：**① ⭐⭐方法被歸到一個具名框架**（讀者可以去找該框架的原始文獻）；**② ⭐⭐每個國家與性別**各自選一個校準期****（參數化是國家級的，而不是一套參數用到底）；**③ ⭐⭐說明產出用途為**人口基準****（逐字「這些表意在作為精算工作的人口基準，尤其在養老金與年金語境下」）。**⑤ ⭐ 其餘**：逐字說明倉庫裡放的是**文檔、源碼與算出來的死亡率表**（產物本身入庫）；項目名裡含一個保險集團縮寫（資助或發起方被寫進項目名）；作者署名含一個全國性精算協會與一家保險公司（本詞條只如實轉述其署名）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 可與 [[mortalitylaws]]、[[stmomo]]、[[cvmortalitymult]]、[[gprmortality]]、[[mortcast]]、[[european-actuarial-journal]]、[[annals-of-actuarial-science]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **三重信號一致指向沒有許可聲明****：GitHub 許可字段為 **NONE**、**默認分支 `master` 的根目錄 `LICENSE` 與 `LICENSE.md` 均不存在（raw 探測均為 HTTP 404）**、**且 README 全文以「licen／copyright／©」檢索**零命中**——**本條尤其要緊：它明確包含「算出來的死亡率表」與一份技術報告，而「可以讀到」與「可以再分發」是兩件事**（⚠️ 尤其人口死亡率數據通常另有來源條款——本詞條未查任何數據來源條款）。**② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **本次沒有運行它的任何一步****——**未安裝 R、未渲染那份 R Markdown 技術報告、未運行任何建模代碼、未打開其任何數據或結果、未打開任何圖**；**故不主张**其 Lee–Carter 類型建模、其校準期選擇或其任何一張死亡率表按所述工作**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未核實**其數據來源與授權**（未核對它用哪一國人口數據、是否可再分發、以及其「動態表」的更新時間口徑）——**這是本條目最需要後續核實的一處**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其表的實務適用性**（其自述把這一項列為產出之一，而本詞條未做任何比較或檢驗）。**⑤ ⭐ ⚠️ **一處**署名與關聯**如實記錄**：README 開頭署名為一位具名作者＋一個全國性精算協會＋一家保險公司，項目名裡另含一個保險集團縮寫——本詞條只如實轉述其署名，⚠️ **不主张**其與任何機構的關係細節。**⑥ ⚠️ **★0、fork 0、無 topics**，且**未核實其提交歷史**。**⑦ ⚠️ **倉庫體量 426 MB****——本詞條如實記錄：這**屬於本站所收條目裡體量最大的一檔**，故**本次未下載其任何內容**。**⑧ ⚠️ **本條目所記為**2026-09-11 所見****。**核實說明**：repo 於 2026-09-11 經倉庫檢索接口與 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 12,548 位元組經 raw 實測逐字核對（含其署名行、兩份產出的說明、國家集與方法一節）；根目錄 `LICENSE` 與 `LICENSE.md` 的存在經 raw 探測確認（均為 HTTP 404）；**未克隆、未下載其 426 MB 內容、未安裝 R 或任何包、未渲染任何報告、未運行任何代碼、未打開任何數據或圖、未做其他網絡觀察**。

**cee-longevity-tables** (repository `kainhofer/PensionLongevity`) **is a project assessing longevity risk for pension plans in central and eastern Europe**, stating its aim verbatim as supporting pension providers in various eastern European countries in their risk management assessments **while also giving actuaries tools and measures to convey the relevant topics to management and policymakers**. **Measured 0 stars, 0 forks, a licence field of NONE** — ⚠️ three signals agreeing, as set out below — **primary language HTML, a 426,145 KB repository, created 2026-05-31 and last pushed 2026-09-10, with master as the default branch** (all GitHub API measurements; ⭐ **creation and push both inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 12,548 bytes and opens by naming its author together with a national actuarial association and an insurance company**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **source and generated artefact**, and ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it states most clearly which of its products counts as the formal document**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① It states the rank of its two outputs** — verbatim, the project consists of two related outputs, a scientific article prepared for submission to **a European actuarial journal** and a detailed **practitioner-oriented technical report generated from R Markdown**, and **the technical report is the primary project documentation**, containing the **full country-level derivations, diagnostic comments, practical recommendations and appendices**, while the journal article provides a **shorter academic summary** of the methodology, selected results and cross-country comparisons ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the primary document is the technical report rather than the article**, ⭐ **which this entry reads as the most unusual answer collected here to the question of what counts as the formal document, since the long practitioner-facing report is placed first and the paper second**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the difference in content between the two is spelled out**, the report holding full country-level derivations, diagnostics, recommendations and appendices **while the article holds only methodology, selected results and cross-country comparison**, ⭐ **so a reader knows which to read**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the technical report is produced from R Markdown**, ⭐ **so the primary document is itself a generated artefact whose source lies elsewhere**; **and ⭐⭐ the article’s intended venue is named.** **② ⭐⭐⭐ It lists its artefacts one by one, the last being suitability itself** — verbatim, the main focus is on population mortality levels, **age-specific mortality improvement rates**, dynamic population mortality tables, **projected life expectancies**, annuity present values, **and the practical suitability of the resulting tables for actuarial use** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **of the six items three are quantities, one is a rate and the last is a judgement**, namely whether the tables are practically suitable, ⭐ **so whether it can be used is itself counted as a product, the same family as the earlier entry recording which numbers have no basis, though here the suitability question is asked of the project’s own output**; ⭐⭐⭐ **dynamic is a property of the table**, ⭐ **so it is not a single static table but one that advances with the year**; **and ⭐⭐ projected life expectancies and annuity present values are both listed**, ⭐ **the output serving both pension and annuity uses**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its country set is enumerated and target countries are distinguished from benchmarks** — verbatim the set includes eleven named countries across central and eastern Europe, **and for comparison purposes selected western European benchmark countries are also considered, in particular the German-speaking region** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **eleven countries are named one by one, so coverage can be checked rather than left as several countries in the region**; ⭐⭐ **the benchmarks are marked as being for comparison, so the two groups play different roles in the method**; **and ⭐⭐ a regional abbreviation is used for the benchmarks**, ⭐ **so grouping follows language or region rather than broad country class**. **④ ⭐⭐ Its method is written as one checkable sentence** — verbatim, the projections are based on a **named modelling framework**, and **for each country and sex, age-specific mortality rates are analysed over time and a country-specific calibration period is selected** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **the method is attributed to a named framework, so a reader can go to its original literature**; ⭐⭐ **each country and sex gets its own calibration period**, ⭐ **so parameterisation is per country rather than one set of parameters throughout**; **and ⭐⭐ the intended use is stated as a population benchmark** for actuarial work, especially in pension and annuity contexts. **⑤ ⭐ Other details**: **the repository is stated verbatim to hold the documentation, source code and the resulting mortality tables**, ⭐ **so the artefacts themselves are committed**; **an insurance group’s abbreviation appears in the project name**, ⭐ **so the funder or sponsor is in the name**; **and the author line carries a national actuarial association and an insurance company**, ⭐ **which this entry reports as stated without claiming any detail of those relationships**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Readable with** [[mortalitylaws]], [[stmomo]], [[cvmortalitymult]], [[gprmortality]], [[mortcast]], [[european-actuarial-journal]] and [[annals-of-actuarial-science]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Three signals agree that there is no licence statement**: **the GitHub licence field is NONE**, **neither a licence file nor a licence markdown file exists at the root of the default branch, both raw probes returning 404**, **and the readme returns no hit for licence, copyright or the copyright sign** — ⭐ **and this matters especially here, because the repository explicitly contains computed mortality tables and a technical report, so being readable and being redistributable are two different things**, ⚠️ **population mortality data in particular usually carrying its own source terms, none of which were examined here**. **② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ Nothing in it was run** — **no R installation, the technical report not rendered, no modelling code run, none of its data or results opened and none of its figures viewed**; **so this entry does not claim its framework, its calibration-period selection or any of its mortality tables works as described**, ⭐ **what it verified being the verbatim README**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ Its data provenance and permissions were not verified**, ⭐ **so which country’s population data it uses, whether those data may be redistributed, and what update basis its dynamic tables follow were not checked** — ⭐ **the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**. **④ ⚠️ The practical suitability of its tables was not verified**, ⭐ **the project listing suitability as one of its outputs while this entry made no comparison or test**. **⑤ ⭐ ⚠️ One attribution note is recorded plainly**: **the readme opens by naming an author together with a national actuarial association and an insurance company, and the project name carries an insurance group’s abbreviation**, ⭐ **which this entry reports as stated**, ⚠️ **asserting nothing about the relationships involved**. **⑥ ⚠️ At 0 stars with no forks and no topics, its commit history was not verified**. **⑦ ⚠️ The repository measures 426 MB**, ⭐ **which this entry records plainly as among the largest collected here, so nothing of its contents was downloaded**. **⑧ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11**. **Verification note**: the repository was read on 2026-09-11 through the repository search endpoint and the GitHub API for stars, licence field, language, size, dates and default branch; the 12,548-byte readme was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim, **including its attribution line, its account of the two outputs, its country set and its method section**; licence file probes against the root returned 404; **nothing was cloned, none of its 426 MB was downloaded, R and no package were installed, no report was rendered, no code was run, no data or figure was opened, and no other network observation was made**.
